summary: Share native prompt answer state and stable retries across web views

replay.detail: Client overlays do not alter claim replay.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Prompt grants, episodes and server fences retain their existing authority.

compatibility.detail: Native prompt answers join the connection-wide optimistic lifecycle. Failed prompt answers expose Retry in every view, retaining the original answer, fence and idempotency key. Message-read transport uses the same lifecycle with rollback refusal policy.

recovery.detail: Reload discards local overlays; authoritative prompt answers remain unchanged.
